patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with centered content blocks, frequently featuring large, embedded terminal UI screenshots or videos.
Prominent, large, sans-serif headings paired with smaller, clean body text and distinct monospace text for code examples and terminal output.
A high-contrast palette of white backgrounds and dark text, accented by a soft lavender/purple for UI elements and a warm orange for announcements.
Scroll-triggered reveals for content sections, where large terminal UI examples and text blocks fade or slide into view as the user scrolls down the page.
Dedicated sections for social proof (logos, stats), detailed feature explanations using interactive terminal UIs, and a clear download/call-to-action section.

technique_notes: The site uses a sticky navigation bar that transforms slightly (gains a subtle shadow/border) after the initial scroll depth, providing persistent access to navigation.

Content sections, particularly the large terminal UI demonstrations, are revealed using scroll-triggered animations (likely CSS keyframes as detected), appearing with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport.
The hero section features an embedded video or animated GIF of the product's terminal UI, providing a dynamic and immediate demonstration of the software (video-hero detected).

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, modern sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, legible body text and distinct monospace for code examples.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons, input fields, and card-like UI elements, maintaining a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, becoming denser in the download options and footer.

standout: The site's distinctive use of the terminal UI itself as the primary visual and interactive element throughout the design, integrating it seamlessly into feature explanations and demonstrations, creating a highly product-centric and authentic experience for developers.
